rationale: This issue centers on safeguards failing under pressure, from teens in crisis to cities stonewalling surveillance oversight to compliance models ignoring their own rules. Small-model cost wins and new visual interfaces show capability advancing even as oversight lags.

assignments.angle: Reports Common Sense Media rated ChatGPT for Teens an unacceptable risk after finding engagement cues persist even in mental-health crises despite August safeguards.
